summary: 澳大利亚巨型动物是否与人类长期共存，关系到怎样解释它们的灭绝。作者重审卡迪泉遗址的骨头、石器和测年结果，提出洪水搬运可能造成遗物混合，使长期共存的证据减弱。
logic: 提出共存时间与灭绝之谜
介绍骨头和石器同层的发现
检查木炭年代及地层矛盾
以洪水搬运重估原解释

paragraphs.brief: 巴里·布鲁克理查德·吉莱斯皮和保罗·马丁之前关于长期共存的说法有争议
sentences: Just how long did humans live side by side with megafauna in Australia?
人类和巨型动物一起在澳大利亚生活了多久？
Barry Brook, Richard Gillespie and Paul Martin dispute previous claims of a lengthy coexistence.
巴里·布鲁克理查德·吉莱斯皮和保罗·马丁之前关于长期共存的说法有争议

paragraphs.brief: 但是，如果巨型动物在人类到达后不久灭绝，那么人类就是可能的罪魁祸首。
sentences: Over the past 50 millennia, Australia has witnessed the extinction of many species of large animals, including a rhinoceros-sized wombat and goannas the size of crocodiles.
在过去50万年中，澳大利亚目睹了许多大型动物物种的灭绝，其中包括一只大小如鳄鱼大小的犀牛腹形动物和大猩猩。
Debate about the possible cause of these extinctions has continued for more than 150 years, and one of the crucial questions raised is how long humans and megafauna coexisted in Australia.
有关这些灭绝的可能原因的辩论已经持续了150多年，提出的关键问题之一是，在澳大利亚，人类和巨型动物的共存时间有多长。
We need to know the overlap of time to make an informed choice between the two main theories regarding the causes of these extinctions.
我们需要知道时间的重叠，以便在有关这些灭绝原因的两个主要理论之间作出知情的选择。
If humans and megafauna coexisted for a protracted period, then climate change is the more likely cause.
如果人类和巨型动物长期共存，那么气候变化就更有可能成为原因。
However, if the megafauna became extinct shortly after the arrival of humans, then humans are the likely culprits.
但是，如果巨型动物在人类到达后不久灭绝，那么人类就是可能的罪魁祸首。

paragraphs.brief: 澳大利亚东部Cuddie Springs的考古遗址似乎得到很好的保护。
sentences: The archaeological site at Cuddie Springs in eastern Australia appears to be well preserved.
澳大利亚东部Cuddie Springs的考古遗址似乎得到很好的保护。

This dusty claypan holds within its sediments a rich cache of flaked stone and seed-grinding tools, and side by side with these clear signals of human culture are the bones of a dozen or more species of megafauna.
这种灰尘粘土在沉积层中蕴藏着大量的碎石和种子农具，与这些人类文化的清晰信号并存，是十几种或更多的巨型动物的骨骼。

Drs Judith Field and Stephen Wroe of the University of Sydney, who excavated the site, claim that it provides unequivocal evidence of a long overlap of humans and megafauna, and conclude that aridity leading up to the last Ice Age brought about their eventual demise.
悉尼大学Judith Field博士和Stephen Wroe博士挖掘了这个网站，他们声称，它提供了人类与巨型动物长期重叠的确凿证据，并得出结论说，导致上一个冰河时代的干旱导致它们最终消亡。

In the long-standing explanation of this site, artefacts such as stone tools and extinct animal remains were deposited over many thousands of years in an ephemeral lake – a body of water existing for a relatively short time – and remained in place and undisturbed until the present day.
古老的解释是，石器和已灭绝的动物遗骸等人工制品在数千年的时间里沉积在一个短暂的湖中 — — 水体存在的时间相对较短 — — 并且一直停留在原地，直到今天都未受到干扰。

paragraphs.brief: Cuddie Springs的骨头和石块密切相连，没有争议，因为两者都在现代地表下1至1.7米处被发现。
sentences: There is no disputing the close association of bones and stones at Cuddie Springs, as both are found 1 to 1.7 metres below the modern surface.
Cuddie Springs的骨头和石块密切相连，没有争议，因为两者都在现代地表下1至1.7米处被发现。

The dating of these layers is accurate: ages for the sediments were obtained through radiocarbon dating of charcoal fragments and luminescence dating of sand grains from the same levels (revealing when a sample was last exposed to sunlight).
这些层层的测相是准确的：沉积物的年限是通过木炭碎片的放射性碳代号以及沙粒的光亮代号从同一水平(在样品最后一次暴露于阳光时出现)。

Intriguingly, some of the stone tools show surface features indicating their use for processing plants, and a few even have well-preserved blood and hair residues suggesting they were used in butchering animals.
令人感兴趣的是，有些石器显示表面特征，表明它们用于加工工厂，有些甚至有保存良好的血和头发残留物，表明它们被用于屠宰动物。

paragraphs.brief: 在现场发现的人类学证据数量惊人：我们估计那里埋有3吨以上的木炭和300吨以上的石头。
sentences: But is the case proposed by Field and Wroe clear-cut?
但Field和Wroe提出的方案是否明确？
We carried out a reanalysis of the scientific data from Cuddie Springs that brings into question their conclusions.
我们重新分析了库迪·斯普林斯的科学数据，使人们对其结论产生疑问。
The amount of anthropological evidence found at the site is remarkable: we estimate there are more than 3 tonnes of charcoal and more than 300 tonnes of stone buried there.
在现场发现的人类学证据数量惊人：我们估计那里埋有3吨以上的木炭和300吨以上的石头。
Field and Wroe estimate that there are approximately 20 million artefacts.
菲尔德和沃尔估计，有约2000万件文物。
This plethora of tools is hard to reconcile with a site that was only available for occupation when the lake was dry.
大量的工具很难与湖干涸时仅可供占用的场地相协调。
Furthermore, no cultural features such as oven pits have been discovered.
此外，没有发现烤箱坑等文化特征。
If the sediment layers have remained undisturbed since being laid down, as Field and Wroe contend, then the ages of those sediments should increase with depth.
如果沉积层自铺设以来一直没有受到干扰，正如Field和Wroe所争论的那样，这些沉积层的年代应该随着深度而增加。
However, our analysis revealed a number of inconsistencies.
然而，我们的分析显示，有一些不一致之处。

paragraphs.brief: 首先，这些煤炭样本都大约36,000年前。
sentences: First, the charcoal samples are all roughly 36,000 years old.
首先，这些煤炭样本都大约36,000年前。
Second, sand in the two upper levels is considerably younger than charcoal from the same levels.
第二，两层高层的沙子比木炭低得多。

Third, Field and Wroe say that the tools and seed-grinding stones used for plant and animal processing are ancient, yet they are very similar to implements found elsewhere that were in use only a few thousand years ago.
第三，Field和Wroe说，用于植物和动物加工的工具和种子采摘石是古老的，但它们与仅仅在几千年前在其他地方发现的器具非常相似。
Also of interest is the fact that a deep drill core made a mere 60 metres from the site recovered no stone artefacts or fossil bones whatsoever.
令人感兴趣的还有，一个深钻芯离该矿址只有60米，但没有发现任何石器或化石骨头。
These points suggest strongly that the sediments have been moved about and some of the old charcoal has been re-deposited in younger layers.
这些要点强烈表明，沉积物已经移动，一些旧木炭被重新存放在较年轻的层。
Indeed, one sample of cow bone found 1 metre below the surface came from sediments where charcoal dated at 6,000 and 23,000 years old is mixed with 17,000-year-old sand.
例如，一块在地表下 1 米处出土的牛骨来自一个沉积层，其中混有距今 6,000 年和 23,000 年的木炭，以及距今 17,000 年的沙。
The megafauna bones themselves have not yet been dated, although new technological developments make this a possibility in the near future.
巨型动物骨骼本身尚未过时，尽管新的技术发展使这种可能性在不远的将来成为可能。

paragraphs.brief: 我们建议考古学家实际取样由古老洪水管道携带的碎片地下，包括木炭运输从林火间歇发生于集水区。
sentences: We propose that the archaeologists have actually been sampling the debris carried by ancient flood channels beneath the site, including charcoal transported from bushfires that intermittently occurred within the catchment.
我们建议考古学家实际取样由古老洪水管道携带的碎片地下，包括木炭运输从林火间歇发生于集水区。
Flood events more likely explain the accumulation of megafauna remains, and could have mixed old bones with fresh deposits.
洪水事件更可能解释巨型动物遗骸的积累，并可能把旧骨头与新鲜矿床混在一起。
European graziers also disturbed the site in 1876 by constructing a well to provide water for their cattle.
1876年，欧洲的荒漠者还修建了一口水井，为牛提供水，从而扰乱了该地。

Given the expense of well-digging, we speculate that the graziers made sure it was protected from the damage caused by cattle hooves by lining the surface with small stones collected from further afield, including prehistoric quarries.
鉴于挖掘井的费用，我们推测，那些护林员通过用从远处收集的小石头，包括史前采石场，在地表上铺设衬垫，确保保护其免受牛蹄的破坏。

This idea is consistent with the thin layer of stones spread over a large area, with cattle occasionally breaking through the gravel surface and forcing the stone and even cattle bones deeper into the waterlogged soil.
这一想法与散布在大片地区的薄石层是一致的，牛偶而冲破碎石表面，迫使石头甚至牛骨深入水深土。

paragraphs.brief: 这表明，与世界其他地方一样，人类来到以前只有动物居住的土地上，形成了一种挥发性的组合，大型动物在其中出丑。
sentences: The lack of conclusive evidence that humans and megafauna coexisted for a lengthy period casts doubt on Field and Wroe’s assertion that climate change was responsible for the extinction of Australia’s megafauna.
缺乏关于人类和巨型动物长期共存的确凿证据使人怀疑Field和Wroe关于气候变化是造成澳大利亚巨型动物灭绝的原因的说法。
However, we do not suggest that newly arrived, well-armed hunters systematically slaughtered all the large beasts they encountered.
然而，我们不认为新到的、装备精良的猎人有系统地屠杀他们遇到的所有大野兽。

Recent studies based on the biology of modern-day large mammals, combined with observations of people who still practise a traditional hunter-gatherer lifestyle, reveal an unexpected paradox and suggest a further possible explanation as to what happened.
最近根据现代大型哺乳动物生物学进行的研究，加上对仍在奉行传统狩猎采集生活方式的人的观察，揭示出一种出乎意料的矛盾现象，并提出了对所发生的情况的进一步可能解释。
Using a mathematical model, it was found that a group of 10 people killing only one juvenile Diprotodon each year would be sufficient to bring about the extinction of that species within 1,000 years.
数学模型表明，一个 10 人的小组即使每年只杀死一只幼年双门齿兽，也足以使这个物种在 1,000 年内灭绝。
This suggests that here, as in other parts of the world, the arrival of humans in lands previously inhabited only by animals created a volatile combination in which large animals fared badly.
这表明，与世界其他地方一样，人类来到以前只有动物居住的土地上，形成了一种挥发性的组合，大型动物在其中出丑。

items.en: Field and Wroe argue that findings at the Cuddie Springs site show that people lived in this area at the same time as megafauna.
items.zh: Field和Wroe认为，Cuddie Springs站点的调查结果表明，人们与巨型动物同时生活在这一地区。
items.why: 菲尔德和罗明确把同一遗址的石器与巨型动物骨骼解读为人类和巨型动物曾长期共存的证据，题干问的正是这两位研究者的观点。

items.en: Field and Wroe believe it is likely that smaller megafauna species survived the last Ice Age.
items.zh: Field和Wroe认为，较小型的巨型动物在上一个冰河时代存活下来的可能性很大。
items.why: 菲尔德和罗认为冰期前的干旱导致巨型动物灭绝，但文中没有按体形分别讨论，更没有说其中较小的物种可能熬过了冰期。

items.en: The writers believe that the dating of earth up to 1.7 m below the present surface at Cuddie Springs is unreliable.
items.zh: 作者认为，在Cuddie Springs，地球在目前表面下方达1.7米的约会是不可靠的。
items.why: 题干说“the writers believe…is unreliable (作者认为不可靠)”,而原文明确说“The dating…is accurate (是准确的)”,与题干陈述正好相反，因此答案为 NO。注意这里问的是作者对“年代测定"的态度，而不是对 Field & Wroe 结论整体的态度。

items.en: Some artefacts found at Cuddie Springs were preserved well enough to reveal their function.
items.zh: 在Cuddie Springs发现的一些文物保存得足够好，足以揭示其功能。
items.why: 题干里的“preserved well enough to reveal their function (保存得足以看出功能)” 对应文 th “surface features indicating their use…well-preserved blood and hair residues suggesting they were used.."。工具上的痕迹和残留物很好地保留下来，使考古学家能判断它们是用来加工植物和宰杀动物的，因此陈述与原文一致, i YES.

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: One objection to Field and Wroe’s interpretation is the large quantity of charcoal, ________ and artefacts found at Cuddie Springs.
items.zh: 反驳菲尔德与罗观点的一项证据，是在卡迪泉发现的大量木炭、________ 和人工制品。
items.why: 31空格与“charcoal, 31…and artefacts” 构成并列三项，对应原文“charcoal and…stone…artefacts"”。选项中只有 stone 与此完全对应。其他如 seeds / sand / fossil bones 都没与木炭一起出现过，因此排除。

items.en: Such large numbers of artefacts would be impossible if the area had been covered with ________ for a period.
items.zh: 如果这里曾有一段时间被 ________ 覆盖，就不可能留下这么多人工制品。
items.why: 逻辑是: 如果湖里有水 (lake not dry),人类就不能长期居住、留下大量器物。所以 summary 写成: 大量器物不可能出现在被 water 覆盖了很长时间的地区。与原文“only available…when the lake was dry”是反向改写，对应 F water。

items.en: There is also a complete lack of man-made structures, for instance those used for ________.
items.zh: 当地也完全没有发现人造设施，例如用于 ________ 的设施。
items.why: “oven pits” 是用来做饭、烹饪的灶坑，因此空格应是“cooking"。题干用“man-made Structures..for instance those used for 33" 来概括“oven pits"。其他选项如 storage / seeds 都不对应“oven pits" 的用途。

items.en: Other evidence that casts doubt on Field and Wroe’s claim is the fact that while some material in the highest levels of sediment is 36,000 years old, the ________ in the same levels is much more recent.
items.zh: 同一沉积层中的材料年代并不一致，这也使人怀疑菲尔德与罗的说法。上层有些材料已有三万六千年，而同层的 ________ 要晚近得多。
items.why: 空格处要填的就是“在同一层中更年轻的东西",原文明确是“sand”,对应选项 C。这里考察的是同层中不同物质年代不一致，成为“inconsistencies” 的一部分。

items.en: Further evidence against human occupation of the area is the absence of tools and ________ just a short distance away.
items.zh: 离遗址不远的地方既没有工具也没有 ________，进一步使人怀疑这里曾有人类居住。
items.why: 离遗址仅六十米的钻芯没有发现石制品，也没有任何化石骨骼。与 tools 并列的答案是 fossil bones。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: What conclusions did the writers reach about the inconsistencies in the data from Cuddie Springs?
items.zh: 作者们对Cuddie Springs数据中的不一致之处得出了什么结论？
correct: The different layers of sediment have been mixed over time.
随着时间的推移，沉积物的不同层层混杂在一起。

items.en: According to the writers, what impact could a natural phenomenon have had on this site?
items.zh: 根据作者的说法，某种自然现象可能给这处遗址造成了什么影响？
correct: Floods could have disturbed the archaeological evidence.
洪水可能会扰乱考古证据

items.en: What did the writers speculate about the people who lived at this site in 1876?
items.zh: 关于1876年生活在这处遗址的人们，作者作了什么推测？
correct: They brought stones there from another area.
他们从另一个地区带了石头到那里。

items.en: In the final paragraph, what suggestion do the writers make about Australia’s megafauna?
items.zh: 最后一段，作者对澳大利亚的巨型动物有什么建议？
correct: Megafauna could have died out as a result of small numbers being killed year after year.
由于年复一年的死亡人数很少，巨型动物可能已经死亡。

items.en: Which of the following best represents the writers’ criticism of Field and Wroe?
items.zh: 下列哪个最好代表作者对菲尔德和罗的批评？
correct: Their conclusions were based on inconsistent data.
他们的结论是基于不一致的数据。

pairs: They brought stones there from another area
从别处运来的石料／从更远处收集的石头
第 2 段 · 第 2 句
points: 菲尔德和罗认为冰期前的干旱导致巨型动物灭绝，但文中没有按体形分别讨论，更没有说其中较小的物种可能熬过了冰期。
“oven pits” 是用来做饭、烹饪的灶坑，因此空格应是“cooking"。题干用“man-made Structures..for instance those used for 33" 来概括“oven pits"。其他选项如 storage / seeds 都不对应“oven pits" 的用途。
clauses: …, then climate change is the more likely cause.
连接词 if 引出“If humans and megafauna coexisted for a protracted period”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
“that there are approximately 20 million artefacts”补足 estimate 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 estimate 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
